description: Creates a component following the design system and repo patterns

<!-- PT-BR: Cria um componente novo reutilizando o design system, com testes e já responsivo. -->
Create the component described below.

Rules:
- Before creating, search the design system and the repo for something equivalent; if it exists, propose reusing it.
- Follow the folder structure and names already used in the project.
- Typed props, loading/error/empty states when they make sense, basic accessibility.
- Responsive for the product's target (see Responsiveness in the repo instructions): desktop widths for internal tools, mobile-first for external products.
- Keep state local to the component. No manual memo unless measured.
- Also create the component test (see the testing instructions).
- Do not commit or push.
